paths.role: login: starts the Gateway-owned OIDC sign-in and redirects to the upstream authorization endpoint
oidc_callback: the upstream redirects the browser here with code and state

match: exact path; each path is forwarded WITHOUT authenticate-oidc; no wildcard and no other path is implied
cookie_path_note: The Path attribute of this cell's cookies, NOT an ALB path. The download page and its routes are OG-x-1's; OG-x-1 names its own paths, and they must sit at or under this cookie path for the browser session to reach them.
upstream_redirect_uri: <PUBLIC_BASE_URL>/schwab/download/callback -- listed on the upstream app registration; not an ALB rule
methods_note: Starlette serves HEAD for every GET route, so HEAD is listed as served.
